_note: Sanitized reproduction data for the TRACE Phase-1B hero incident. All values are public on-chain data or Nansen-returned labels captured during discovery on 2026-09-21. No secrets. Addresses are public. This file is enough to reproduce the reconstruction locally; it does NOT assert intent or causation.

incident.name: Euler Finance exploit and fund return
incident.one_line: A flash-loan-funded exploit drained Euler Finance, followed by an unusual multi-day on-chain return of most funds.

attacker_eoa.note: Top counterparty of the Nansen 'Euler Exploiter' entity; volume in=out=$378.4M, interaction_count 108.

first_funder.note: Returned by profiler/address/related-wallets for the attacker EOA. Funding occurred immediately before exploit activity.

queries.note: paginate to reach 2023-03-13 exploit-day rows; default ordering returned latest first

evidence_model.FACT: counterparty addresses, Nansen labels, interaction_count, volumes, tx timestamps, tx methods returned directly by Nansen
evidence_model.DERIVED: chronological ordering, cumulative/net volume, step count computed by TRACE
evidence_model.RELATION: 'First Funder' link (attacker EOA <- 0x036cec...) and counterparty edges returned by Nansen
evidence_model.HYPOTHESIS: that the flash loan was taken 'for' the attack, or any claim of intent/causation. TRACE must render this as hypothesis, never fact.
